 Wat ga je doen? 
As a part-time mail carrier at PostNL in Sevenum, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. You can organise your own schedule, which makes this job very flexible. 
Your day starts at the depot in your neighbourhood, where you collect the mail for your route. You sort the letters and get your bike ready. Then you're ready to go!  Waar ga je werken? 
You will be working at PostNL, the largest postal and parcel company in the Netherlands. Every day, they ensure that millions of letters and parcels are delivered to the right destination, both within the Netherlands and abroad. 
As a mail carrier, you work independently. You start your day by collecting the mail and have until 6:00 PM to sort and deliver everything. This allows you to largely determine your own pace and how you organise your day. 
The location is accessible from Venray, Horst, America, Hegelsom, Meterik, Sevenum, Melderslo and Grubbenvorst. Do you live in one of these places? If so, you may even be able to cycle to the depot. jobs.occupation: Duty manager internship Moxy/Residence Inn - Moxy/Residence Inn
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an internship with responsibility? Are you always up for a challenge and something different? Then we have the perfect internship for you at Moxy and Residence Inn Houthavens Amsterdam!

Our Duty Trainee is someone who can do it all and is not afraid to get his/her hands dirty or shy away from a challenge. You must be familiar with the company, equipment and emergency procedures. As a Duty Trainee, you have a good knowledge of all operational departments and are happy to help them in times of need! Complaints are a challenge for you because you are an excellent problem solver with a sense of humor and can turn any complaint or issue into a brilliant and spirited experience!

Moxy & Residence Inn Houthavens is managed by Vertiq Hospitality Partners, formerly known as Cycas Hospitality, established in 2008. Vertiq Hospitality Partners is evolving from a hotel management company to an operating partner with a clear Vision: to be the trusted operating partner in European hospitality investments.

What you will do during this internship:

• You will assist in all departments (front office, F&B, housekeeping etc.).
• You will be able to present yourself as a manager to the guests of the hotel.
• You will learn to deal with guest requests or complaints.
• A duty manager intern is expected to make the right decisions the moment a problem arises.
• You will gain knowledge about the hotel and what to do in emergency situations.
• You do quality rounds and Brand audit checks.
• You will check rooms to verify the outside cleaning company.
• Making orders
• Other projects
• You will work early and late shifts, including weekends and holidays

 

Who are you?

• You are eager to learn and creative
• You master the English language, Dutch is an advantage.
• You follow a relevant HBO study (hotel - facility - tourism)
• You are sociable and enjoy working in a diverse team
• You are flexible and able to work different shifts, including weekends and holidays
